title: INC-9734: incident on the Data Lake Ingest
body:
Impact

This report covers an incident on the Data Lake Ingest that
is ongoing. About 22 customer tickets were linked to it by
Data Services, with Silverline Data engaged as the hosting
provider from the first hour.

Timeline

Timeline recorded by Mei Chen, in order, as of 25 November
2025:
- Error rates were compared against the weekly baseline
- A disk on the storage node reported write failures
- Certificates on the edge proxies were renewed by hand

Status

Data Services lists the incident as under investigation.
Report written by Rohan Mehta on 26 August 2025; the next
review falls in the 01:00-03:00 UTC window and goes to the
weekly service meeting.
